title: 厦门三角梅早安海报
author: @小小东
categories: 海报 / 传单,社交媒体帖子,摄影,风景 / 自然,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a bright, elegant morning greeting poster for Xiamen, combining a floral city-symbol aesthetic with weather, clothing advice, and a soft editorial layout.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal poster, about 1200×675 px. Use a clean white and pastel sky-blue background with soft bokeh, high-key sunlight, gentle haze, and a fresh early-morning atmosphere.

Main visual: A large close-up branch of vivid pink bougainvillea flowers fills the center and right side, with translucent papery petals, visible veins, tiny cream-white flower centers, green leaves, and sparkling dew drops. Keep the flowers realistic but polished, like a premium lifestyle magazine cover. Add a second blurred cluster of pink bougainvillea in the far right background for depth.

Typography and layout: Place a very large, ultra-thin, pale pink handwritten English title across the top reading “GOOD MORNING,” spanning nearly the full width and blending subtly into the background. On the upper left, add a small Chinese greeting block reading “早安，厦门” and below it “海风轻拂，花色正好,” with a tiny pink line-flower doodle nearby. Along the far left edge, add a vertical city label “XIAMEN” and a small heart marker with the word “AMOY.”

Main information card: At the lower left, create one large frosted-glass rounded rectangle card with soft shadow and translucent white fill. It contains exactly 4 visible content groups: 1) a small pink dot in the upper-left corner of the card; 2) the main headline in large black Chinese calligraphy-style type, “厦门早安”; 3) spaced romanization below, “XIAMEN ZAO AN”; 4) the date line “2026.06.25° / 星期四” in clean modern type. Use 2026.06.25 as the date and 星期四 as the weekday.

Right information panel: Attached to or overlapping the main card on the lower center-right, add one smaller frosted-glass rounded rectangle panel separated by a faint vertical divider. It contains exactly 3 stacked rows with thin divider lines: 1) weather row with a small blue rainy-cloud icon and text “今日天气 | 小雨转多云 28–32°C” plus subtext “午后有雷阵雨，体感闷热”; 2) city flower row with a pink outline flower icon and text “城市花意 | 三角梅 Bougainvillea”; 3) clothing advice row with a lime-green outline T-shirt icon and text “穿衣建议 | 轻薄短袖 + 透气下装” plus subtext “随身带伞，注意防晒，午后防雨 空调房可备薄外搭.” Use 小雨转多云 28–32°C and 三角梅 for these fields.

Top-right badge: Add one vertical rounded pink translucent label at the upper right with a tiny flower icon, the text “城市花意,” the large Chinese flower name “三角梅,” and small italic English “Bougainvillea.”

Decorative overlays: Include exactly 3 translucent color blocks: 1) a pale blue rounded rectangle peeking from the lower left behind the card, 2) a large faint pink rectangle at the lower right, and 3) a vertical blush-pink strip behind the top-right badge. Use airy spacing, delicate shadows, and pastel accents.

Style constraints: Modern Chinese social-media greeting-card design, refined and calm, suitable for middle-aged and older audiences. Keep all text crisp and readable, no watermark, no extra logos, no people, no clutter, no additional flowers beyond the bougainvillea theme.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a bright anime cheerleader pose reference sheet for a sports-stadium performance, showing a silver-haired anime cheerleader demonstrating exactly 15 cheer motions in separate numbered panels.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 contact-sheet layout, 1280x720 style, divided into a clean 5-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a thin white border, a blue circular number badge in the top-left, a white slanted title banner across the top with bold blue uppercase English text, and a dark translucent caption bar along the bottom with Japanese explanatory text.

Setting and visual style: Sunny outdoor football stadium with green field, running track, curved grandstands, vivid blue sky, fluffy clouds, energetic idol-cheer atmosphere. High-quality anime illustration, glossy promotional look, dynamic wide-angle camera, bright rim light, saturated blue-and-white palette, crisp details, motion in hair and skirt. The character wears a blue-and-white cheerleader outfit: cropped sleeveless top with star motif, pleated mini skirt, blue ribbons, thigh garter accents, ankle shoes, and large blue-and-white pom-poms. Long flowing silver-white twin-tail hair with blue bows, cute expressive idol style.

Layout and exact panel list: Include exactly 15 panels, ordered left to right, top to bottom:
1. HIGH V — both arms raised high in a V shape with pom-poms.
2. LOW V — both arms extended diagonally downward in a low V stance.
3. T MOTION — arms stretched straight sideways at shoulder height.
4. TOUCHDOWN — one arm raised high and the other extended diagonally downward.
5. HIGH TOUCH — one hand reaches straight upward as if touching high, one leg lifted playfully.
6. LOW TOUCH — leaning forward with one arm reaching low toward the ground.
7. HALF TIME — hands placed on hips, ready stance.
8. CLAP — pom-poms brought together in front, clapping rhythmically.
9. PUNCH — one arm thrust powerfully upward with pom-pom.
10. SPIN — spinning in place, skirt and hair flaring outward.
11. KICK — high leg kick with energetic balance.
12. LUNGE — one knee bent deeply in a strong lunge pose.
13. JUMP — jumping upward with pom-pom raised and legs tucked.
14. BOW — polite forward bow with pom-poms gathered in front.
15. FINISH POSE — final celebratory pose with one arm raised and smile.

Text content: Use the English motion titles exactly as listed. Add Japanese captions similar to a cheer instruction guide under each panel, including these meanings: basic high V position, calm low V stance, synchronized shoulder-height team motion, one hand high and one diagonal, touch high to appeal height, low touch with sparkle, hands on waist for preparation, clap pom-poms to make rhythm, punch upward with strength, spin for華やか movement, dynamic high kick, strong lunge, jump to express energy, graceful bow of thanks, and smiling finish pose. Main title is not needed.

Constraints: Keep the grid perfectly readable and evenly spaced. Use exactly 15 numbered panels and no extra panels. Maintain consistent character design, outfit, colors, and stadium background across all panels. Make the typography bold and legible. Avoid logos, watermarks, and unrelated objects.\

She holds one hand near her chest as if restraining emotion. Backlight her with a luminous full moon and drifting red-black particles.

Top text: Large headline: スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』. Subtitle below: 『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの.

Left symbolic panel: Exactly 1 left panel titled 血. Visual: crimson-black tree shaped like veins or blood vessels, red ribbons of blood, shadowy running horse silhouettes at the bottom, circular gothic frame. Text inside: 血統・本能・競走への衝動. Smaller text: 自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力.

Middle-lower symbolic panel: Exactly 1 wide panel titled 背徳. Visual: left side black rose wrapped in thorns, right side pale hand reaching through thorns with a small drop of blood, ornate elongated frame. Main text: 愛の危うさ・独占・越境. Smaller text: 愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる.
